Compliance Specialist

Lauren Deutsch*, non-attorney professional

Lauren Deutsch is a Compliance Specialist at The Political Law Group, where she supports clients with day-to-day federal and state campaign finance compliance, including preparing reports, maintaining client records and assisting with ongoing reporting obligations.

lauren@tpl.group

Lauren’s background includes political fundraising, congressional constituent services and legislative advocacy. Prior to joining TPLG, she supported fundraising programs for federal candidates, working with campaign and donor data, fundraising communications and event operations. She has also worked in a congressional district office and for a statewide advocacy organization, gaining experience with constituent casework, legislative developments and grassroots advocacy programs.

*Denotes a non-attorney professional.
